About RemotePass

RemotePass exists because talent is distributed equally, but opportunity is not. Backed by EBRD and trusted by 800+ companies across 150+ countries, RemotePass is the platform that gives businesses the infrastructure to hire anyone, anywhere — and gives workers in emerging markets the financial tools and global access they deserve.

RemotePass is the only platform that combines Employer of Record, contractor management, direct employment, and corporate spend cards in a single product — rated 4.8/5 on G2, trusted by Spotify, Logitech, and Deloitte, and operating across 150+ countries. We are backed by leading global investors, including Oraseya Capital, Endeavor Catalyst, Khwarizmi Ventures, Flyer One Ventures, Access Bridge Ventures, A15, Swiss Founders Fund, and Plug & Play.

The role

RemotePass verifies, screens, and monitors clients and contractors through risk-based onboarding and compliance workflows before payment activity is enabled. We're growing our Compliance Operations team and looking for an Analyst to help handle the day-to-day: reviewing company documents, verifying contractor identities, running sanctions checks, and flagging anything that doesn't look right.

You'll work closely with two other analysts and report into our Head of Operations, with our Head of Compliance as your escalation point for anything that needs a second set of eyes. You don't need to be a compliance expert on day one — you need real hands-on exposure to KYC/KYB and a sharp eye for detail, and we'll help you build the rest.

What you'll do

  • Review client KYB documentation — corporate registration, ownership structure, proof of operations, authorized representatives
  • Support contractor KYC — verifying IDs, resolving address or payment detail mismatches, handling jurisdictional flags
  • Run sanctions, PEP, and adverse media checks using our approved tools and procedures
  • Investigate payment issues — failed payouts, payment detail changes, cross-border payment concerns
  • Keep our compliance trackers, evidence folders, and case notes accurate and audit-ready
  • Escalate potential fraud, sanctions risk, unusual activity, or policy violations quickly and clearly.
  • Work cross-functionally with Customer Success and Operations on client-facing requests

Requirements

  • 1-3 years of hands-on compliance experience — KYC, KYB, client/customer onboarding, or sanctions screening, ideally at a payment processor, bank, crypto exchange, or money transmitter
  • Comfortable reviewing documents carefully and spotting what's missing, inconsistent, or unclear
  • Good written English — you can write a clean case note and a clear client request
  • Comfortable with spreadsheets, case queues, and juggling multiple open cases at once
  • High attention to detail, with the judgment to know when something needs to be escalated rather than closed
  • Arabic fluency is a strong plus, not a requirement

Benefits

  • Remote-First Culture: We don't just sell remote work; we live it. Enjoy the flexibility to work from anywhere.
  • Hyper-Growth: Be part of a company that is consistently recognized for its rapid expansion and innovation.
  • Inclusion Matters: We are committed to building a diverse team. We value different perspectives and empower every individual to bring their authentic self to work.

Job Title

US & MEX Portfolio Planner

Job Description Summary

C&W strategists enable confident, fact-based decisions and design and execute integrated, innovative solutions to achieve continual productivity gains that drive enterprise value. We assist our clients in aggregating and analyzing data to drive portfolio optimization scenarios and decisions that better align with business needs and objectives. We employ the best workplace and occupancy planning strategies to enable employee productivity and minimize business disruption – while easily responding to changing business needs.

Job Description

Cushman & Wakefield is seeking a US / LAM Portfolio Planner to be fully dedicated to a Large Banking Client’s global account, to drive strategic planning and optimization actions across multiple geographies. We are looking for a highly proactive candidate with strong written and oral communication skills and industry experience who values collaboration, integrity and our clients’ ultimate satisfaction with the services we provide.

The role focuses on research and analysis that translates data into insights supporting recommendations and client deliverables.

Working under the guidance of senior team members, the consultant contributes to the development of client presentations and supports stakeholder engagement activities while building core consulting and communication skills.

Partner effectively with senior regional and country Real Estate leaders and business stakeholders to understand requirements, manage expectations, and translate strategic objectives into actionable recommendations across portfolio and workplace initiatives.

Job Responsibilities

Responsibilities:

  • Analyze the client’s real estate portfolio and develop strategies and plans to achieve long-term operational and financial goals
  • Collaborate with the C&W platform, C&W service line functions, and with stakeholders within the client’s organization to develop the right solutions for our clients and to drive approval and implementation
  • Lead and facilitate meetings to obtain direction, alignment, and buy-in
  • Assist in efforts to leverage insights, collaboration and delivery to ensure that we are the industry leader in product innovation
  • Support client annual planning, budget development, and decisions
  • Provide summary analyses, write and coordinate engaging client reports and deliverables, manage quality control review of deliverables produced
  • Possess collaborative, inclusive, engaging, inquisitive, and creative demeanor

Strategic Analysis and Insights

  • Gather, organize, and analyze quantitative and qualitative data, helping translate raw inputs into structured insights used in client decision making.
  • Use AI tools to drive efficiency in data analysis and delivery, while remaining accountable for accuracy of outputs.
  • Support analytical approaches, frameworks, and comparative analyses that evaluate current state conditions and explore future state scenarios.

Client Delivery

  • Support stakeholder related activities, such as preparing materials for meetings, interviews, or workshops.
  • Maintain attention to detail, data integrity, and sound judgment in identifying risks, seeking guidance or clarifying assumptions when needed.
  • Assist with scenario-based and comparative analyses related to portfolio optimization, consolidation, expansion, or site selection initiatives.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional certification required
  • 2-4 years of relevant experience
  • Bilingual Spanish-English required

  • Strong critical thinking skills to analyze defined problems and identify key assumptions or gaps

  • Applicable understanding of commercial real estate practices strongly preferred

  • Ability to handle large amounts of data, identify key information, and provide insightful recommendations to all levels within the organization with minimal direction

raw.description:
About the Job

Enabled Energy is seeking a Strategic Partner Manager to build and lead our strategic partner ecosystem.

This is not a traditional sales role and it is not a traditional account management role.

We are looking for someone who can identify, recruit, develop, and grow strategic relationships with organizations that influence our target customers and create opportunities for collaboration. This individual will serve as the primary point of contact for strategic partners and will be responsible for establishing the processes, governance, agreements, and engagement structure needed to create successful long-term relationships.

The ideal candidate brings a combination of business development experience, executive relationship management skills, and industry connections.

What You'll Do

Build and Grow Strategic Partnerships

  • Identify, recruit, and onboard new strategic partners.
  • Expand and strengthen existing partner relationships.
  • Develop executive-level relationships across partner organizations.
  • Build joint business plans that create measurable growth opportunities.
  • Create long-term partner development strategies.

Potential partner types include:

  • Commercial real estate firms
  • Data center consultants
  • Engineering organizations
  • Owner's representatives
  • Energy and sustainability consultants
  • Strategic advisory firms
  • Industry associations and influencers

Own Partner Relationships

  • Serve as the primary relationship owner for all strategic partners.
  • Coordinate communication across sales, delivery, marketing, and executive leadership.
  • Conduct regular business reviews and executive check-ins.
  • Monitor partnership health and proactively address issues.
  • Establish trust and credibility with partner leadership teams.

Build the Partner Program

  • Develop and formalize Enabled Energy's strategic partner program.
  • Create onboarding processes, engagement models, and operating procedures.
  • Establish partner governance and success frameworks.
  • Define partner tiers, expectations, and performance metrics.
  • Build scalable processes that support long-term growth.

Establish Governance and Rules of Engagement

  • Define how opportunities are identified, registered, and managed.
  • Develop account ownership and conflict resolution processes.
  • Create clear expectations for collaboration between partners and Enabled Energy.
  • Work with leadership to develop partnership agreements and commercial frameworks.
  • Ensure consistent execution across all partner relationships.

Generate Pipeline and Support Revenue Growth

  • Drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline growth.
  • Coordinate opportunity handoff to the appropriate Business Development representative.
  • Support joint pursuit planning and strategic account development.
  • Facilitate executive introductions and relationship expansion opportunities.
  • Help drive new logo acquisition through partner channels.

Maintain CRM and Reporting Discipline

  • Ensure all partner activities and opportunities are accurately maintained in Dynamics 365.
  • Track partnership performance and revenue contribution.
  • Develop reporting and dashboards that provide visibility into partner performance.
  • Communicate progress, opportunities, and risks to executive leadership.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 12 months, you will:

  • Expand Enabled Energy's strategic partner ecosystem.
  • Create a formal partner program and governance structure.
  • Increase partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline.
  • Establish executive relationships within key partner organizations.
  • Implement consistent business review and reporting processes.
  • Improve visibility and accountability across all partner-driven opportunities.

What We're Looking For

Required Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in partnerships, strategic alliances, business development, channel management, consulting, or related fields.
  • Proven success developing and growing business relationships.
  • Experience negotiating and managing commercial agreements.
  • Strong executive communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to develop programs, processes, and governance frameworks from the ground up.
  • Experience working across multiple stakeholders and organizational functions.
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms such as Dynamics 365 or Salesforce.

Preferred Experience

  • Existing relationships within the data center, mission critical, energy, infrastructure, engineering, or commercial real estate industries.
  • Experience working with strategic partners, consultants, engineering firms, or owner representatives.
  • Experience developing referral, alliance, or partner programs.
  • Understanding of data center operations, energy efficiency, facility infrastructure, reliability, compliance, or capital project environments.

About Enabled Energy

Enabled Energy helps some of the world's most sophisticated organizations optimize, modernize, and improve the performance of their critical infrastructure. We work alongside clients, consultants, engineering firms, and industry partners to identify opportunities that improve operational efficiency, increase reliability, reduce risk, and unlock capacity.

Job Description

Title: Senior Customer Success Manager

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

The Senior Customer Success Manager is the CEO of your book of business. A high performer who is SaaS revenue focused, responsible for managing and developing multiple medium/large Duck Creek OnDemand and OnPrem accounts. As a SMCS, you will act as the primary contact and trusted advisor for your customers and provide an interface between the Customer/System Integration (SI) partner(s), and internal Duck Creek teams.

Members of the Customer Success family are motivated customer advocates, adept in managing customer needs throughout their journey – from contract signing, multiple go-lives, and contract expansion and renewal. You see our customers’ challenges as opportunities. You use your knowledge of Duck Creek and the software delivery lifecycle (SDLC) process to get into the detail and find solutions. You turn our customers’ pain points into success plans, and work across all arms of the Duck Creek organization to continually drive success.

It is expected that the SMCS will work in collaboration with the Customer Success Engineers (CSEs) and other Customer Success (CS) Organization teams to provide assistance in the management of your customers within a defined segment (e.g., Personal, Commercial, Multi-national, APAC), across a customer’s entire Duck Creek lifecycle to maximize value realization and product adoption.

Manage and develops the customer accounts:

  • Manage 4+ medium/large OnDemand or OnPrem accounts.

  • Develop and foster a trusted relationship with the Customer and SI partners.

  • Meet with Customer leadership teams to understand their business goals and strategic priorities, including the preparation of customer success plans with an eye toward future sales opportunities and product expansion at time of renewal.

  • Stay up to date with the latest features and updates of Duck Creek’s suite of products and services, conduct review sessions, and identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling, including active management of NRR and GRR.

  • Track renewals through their lifecycle, highlighting potential risks, and building strategic account plans to ensure success.

  • Facilitate weekly, monthly, and quarterly customer governance meetings, including preparation of reports, governance decks and working with all parties to schedule customer sessions.

  • Mentors junior Customer Success Managers

Ensures Customer Success and Reference-ability:

  • Gather customer feedback by playing an active role in the NPS customer survey activities by encouraging customer feedback, assessing results, and developing measurable closed loop action plans.

  • Understand what is required to make/keep the Customer a great reference and improve the end user experience by furthering customer adoption.

  • Educate customers on new and existing functionalities (including engaging relevant DC teams to assist) and demonstrate how they can benefit the customer’s business to deliver value.

  • Where issues arise, including pre and post go-live events, conduct lessons learned with various stakeholders to build action plans, coordinate improvements, and turn the account back to green.

  • Act as primary contact point for Customer issues/questions and maintain regular contact with customers to ensure on time go-lives.

  • Work with wider teams involved with the customer (e.g. services teams and partners) to collect and analyze customer feedback with the aim of identifying areas for improvement.

  • Ensure customers are actively planning to adopt the latest version of Duck Creek software.

Interfaces between Customer/SI partner and Internal team:

  • Proactively manage any potential risks and work with applicable resources to implement mitigation plans, including leveraging conformance reviews / delivery assurance process.

  • Ensure all customer support cases logged (via SNOW) receive appropriate attention and urgency, including tracking of defect resolution in line with customer program timelines.

  • Coordinate Customer-specific communication plans, test schedules, releases, and ticket priorities, etc., between Customers and internal and external stakeholders.

  • Ensure transparency into Customer Health by providing a view of internal throughput on customer incidents and requests.

  • Develop the tools / processes / procedures to grow and mature the business to allow for cost-effective future growth and scale.

  • For OnDemand clients, develop and maintain Customer-specific portions of the runbook (e.g., communication plan/contacts).

  • Provide feedback to Engineering teams on how to better enhance our products for Duck Creek customers.

  • Review monthly metrics reports with Customers including SLA targets and actuals, volumetric performance data, major issues and outages.

  • Perform all other duties and activities as required.

  • Act in accordance with and as a good steward of Duck Creek Technologies mission, vision, and core values:

    • Mission: To empower insurers to reimagine the future of insurance

    • Vision: To transform insurance technology, helping insurers be smarter, faster, and more efficient, and ultimately provide the best protection for people and businesses

    • Values: We Prioritize Respect, We Listen, We Care, We Add Value, and We Lead

Education and Work Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree, and/or higher level, or foreign equivalent, in Computer Science, Computer Information Sciences or related degree; related work experience can be substituted for educational requirement.

  • Work Experience: Minimum 6+ years functional and technical knowledge of SaaS platforms.

  • Proven ability to maintain and foster strong relationship with customers

  • Proven experience driving new and expansion sales, driving software adoption, and leveraging customer success best practices

  • Demonstrated operational excellence in analytical thinking, process development and improvement, problem solving, communication, delegation, and planning

  • Able to be flexible and agile in responding to evolving business priorities and dealing with ambiguity

  • Able to collaborate across the organization and with external stakeholders

PREFERRED:

  • Duck Creek Suite and Platform knowledge and experience (preferred).

  • P&C Insurance knowledge and experience (preferred)

  • ChurnZero knowledge and experience (preferred).

  • Knowledge of Microsoft Azure, SQL Server preferred.

  • Leadership Experience: Minimum 1 year (preferred).

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities & Behaviors:

  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

  • Ability to clearly articulate and present technical solutions to prospects/Customers during sales processes.

  • Exceptional customer service and organizational skills are a must.

  • Must be able to work well independently and in a team environment.

  • Efficient multi-tasking and project management skills.

  • Excellent communication skills, both written and oral, ability to communicate with sales, executives, and Customers.

  • Holds strong operational skills that will drive organizational efficiencies and customer satisfaction

Other Requirements:

WHAT WE STAND FOR:  

Our global company celebrates & leverages the differences each employee brings to the table. Our success is a direct result of an inclusive culture where opportunities to learn from one another occur regardless of title, seniority, or background. This collaborative and team-oriented approach is at the core of how we operate and continuously improve our products, services, and systems.  As such, Duck Creek is committed to providing equal opportunity to all employees and applicants – to recruit, hire, train, and reward employees for their individual abilities, achievements, and experience without regard to race, color, gender, religion, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, marital, military, or any other protected status.

raw.description:
Location: Remote (based in Estonia)

Contract: 12 months, full-time, service agreement.

Nidus Balticus is looking for an entrepreneurial and proactive Country Representative to lead and grow our work in Estonia.

This is a highly autonomous role with significant ownership of Nidus Balticus’ strategic delivery in Estonia. You will implement Nidus Balticus’ country strategy, developing programmes, partnerships and policy initiatives that advance our strategic objectives. One priority will be leading the next phase of our work in Ida-Virumaa – strengthening its political and policy impact, developing partnerships around regional priorities, and connecting local priorities with national political and investment decisions. Beyond Ida-Virumaa, you will be expected to identify and develop new programme and partnership opportunities, expand our ecosystem of collaborators, and contribute to shaping Nidus Balticus’ broader policy and campaign agenda in Estonia. As our presence grows, you will build a local team.

You will report directly to the Executive Director and collaborate closely with the Chief Operations Officer, PR Manager, and other Country Leads.

About Nidus Balticus

Nidus Balticus is a non-profit organization working to strengthen energy independence, environmental stewardship, and national security across the Baltics. We bring underrepresented voices into energy and environmental policy conversations, building broad coalitions that connect local communities, civil society, businesses, and policymakers. By turning community engagement into public support, we help create the political momentum needed to deliver lasting policy change.

Nidus Balticus is part of Our Common Home (OCH) – a global network that brings those excluded from the climate movement into the conversation about protecting their environment, on their own terms. Our 10+ network organizations are active across four continents, supported by a global team providing world-class expertise in campaigns, impact measurement, research, and operations.

Key Responsibilities

Country strategy & strategic delivery: Lead the implementation of Nidus Balticus’ Estonia strategy, translating strategic priorities into programmes, campaigns, partnerships and policy initiatives. Identify opportunities to expand our impact and strengthen our presence in Estonia, and take ownership of new initiatives.

Programme development & delivery: Design, launch and deliver strategic campaigns and programmes, including the continued development of our flagship work in Ida-Virumaa. Oversee implementation, coordinate local partners and vendors, manage budgets and timelines, and ensure programmes achieve societal and policy impact.

Partnerships & ecosystem development: Build and nurture an ecosystem of partners across civil society, business, academia, municipalities, and government. Establish strategic partnerships and alliances that strengthen impact, policy influence, and programme delivery.

New opportunities & partnerships: Continuously identify and develop new programme, campaign and partnership opportunities aligned with the mission and country strategy. Identify emerging political and societal needs, assess opportunities for Nidus Balticus to create impact, and turn relevant opportunities into concrete initiatives.

Policy engagement: Build relationships with policymakers and public institutions, contribute to policy discussions, and support our advocacy work in Estonia.

Leadership & team development: Help establish and grow Nidus Balticus' presence in Estonia by identifying future talent, supporting recruitment, and gradually building and leading a high-performing local team.

Public representation: Represent Nidus Balticus at conferences, public events, stakeholder meetings, and in regional media.

Impact & reporting: Monitor programme impact, gather community insights, and contribute to reports, case studies, and learning processes.

Requirements

Experience: 5–8+ years of relevant professional experience in public affairs, advocacy, strategic partnerships, regional development, programme development, community engagement, or ecosystem building, ideally with ownership of complex initiatives or organisational growth.

Stakeholder engagement: Demonstrated ability to build trusted partnerships across different sectors and work effectively with diverse communities.

Ecosystem building: Proven ability to develop multi-stakeholder partnerships and build collaborative ecosystems involving civil society, businesses, public institutions, and local communities.

Regional expertise: Good understanding of Estonia's political, social, and economic landscape. Familiarity with Ida-Virumaa and existing networks in the region would be a strong advantage.

Languages: Fluency in Estonian and English is essential. Russian language skills are highly desirable for engaging diverse communities and stakeholders.

Organization: Strong project management skills with the ability to independently coordinate multiple workstreams.

Communication: Excellent interpersonal and public speaking skills, with the ability to build trust across diverse audiences.

Entrepreneurial mindset: High degree of ownership, autonomy and initiative. Proactively identifies opportunities, is comfortable operating with ambiguity, and can take an initiative from an early opportunity through relationship-building, programme development and implementation.

Who is the Ideal Candidate?

Relevant backgrounds may include:

Community development & NGOs: Experience leading outreach, mobilization, or partnership-building within civil society or community projects.

Public affairs & advocacy: Experience engaging policymakers, public institutions, or industry stakeholders on policy or advocacy initiatives.

Business & industry associations: Experience working within chambers of commerce, business associations, sector organizations, employers' associations, or regional development bodies, bringing stakeholders together around shared policy objectives.

Ecosystem building & strategic partnerships: A proven track record of building cross-sector partnerships between NGOs, businesses, public institutions, research organisations, foundations, or community groups.

Regional development: Experience working with municipalities, local development organizations, regional initiatives, or place-based economic development.

Project management: Experience coordinating initiatives involving multiple partners, timelines, and deliverables.

What We Offer

Autonomy: High degree of freedom in planning and executing your work.

Leadership Opportunity: Shape Nidus Balticus' long-term presence in Estonia, implement the country's strategic vision, and build and lead an agile and ambitiouslocal team.

Meaningful Impact: The opportunity to play a leading role in strengthening communities, building broad societal coalitions, and advancing Estonia's long-term energy security and regional resilience.

Competitive Compensation:

Flexibility: Remote working conditions within an agile, modern organizational culture.

International Network: Learning and networking opportunities within Our Common Home's global network.

Contract: An initial 12-month fixed-term contract, with a strong potential for extension as the organization expands.

Travel: Regular travel within Estonia, particularly to regional communities, and occasional travel across the Baltics for meetings and collaboration.

Thriveworks is a mental health care company founded by clinicians in 2008 and still led by them today. With 340+ locations and a nationwide hybrid care model, we serve over 175,000 clients annually through more than 1.7 million sessions, and we're growing. In addition to working directly with clients, we partner with health systems and primary care providers because we believe mental health is inseparable from physical health. As a clinician-led organization, we're built to support the people who do this work with the tools, community, and stability you need to build a career that lasts.

All clinical leadership is promoted from within, so the people supporting you have been exactly where you are.

Ready to Join Us?
Apply today to become part of a team that’s changing mental health care for clients and clinicians alike.

Your Role at a Glance

Mastercam is redefining the future of manufacturing software by evolving from a world-class desktop CAD/CAM system into an intelligent, connected, and cloud-powered platform. We are seeking a visionary Sr. Product Manager, Cloud & AI Transformation, to lead this evolution, driving the migration from traditional desktop software to a modern, service-based cloud architecture that integrates AI-powered workflows, automation, and data-driven insights.

This strategic leadership role will partner across product, engineering, and business functions to define and execute the roadmap for Mastercam’s next-generation platform. You’ll combine strategic vision with hands-on execution, ensuring our products not only meet the needs of today’s manufacturers but also lead the next era of connected, AI-empowered machining.

How You’ll Drive Success

Cloud & Platform Transformation

  • Define the product roadmap for cloud transformation and ensure it aligns with customer needs, business priorities, and technical direction set by Engineering.
  • Partner with Software Engineering leadership and Architects to define the service strategy, modernization phases, and hybrid delivery capabilities
  • Drive modular Add-On architecture to accelerate feature delivery and partner ecosystem enablement.
  • Collaborate with software engineering to establish the technical vision for hybrid delivery models, balancing local compute performance with cloud-powered intelligence.
  • Ensure integration with Sandvik’s broader cloud ecosystem and alignment with corporate digital transformation objectives.
  • Oversee PLM and 3rd party integration across Mastercam, Sandvik and partner platforms.

AI Enablement & Data Strategy

  • Partner with AI/ML teams to embed intelligent automation, manufacturing insights, and predictive analytics into Mastercam workflows.
  • Define AI-enabled workflows and customer value.
  • Partner with AI Engineering to deliver copilots, automation, and insights.
  • Evaluate third-party AI copilots and automation tools.
  • Develop strategies for telemetry, user analytics, and data pipelines that power continuous improvement and adaptive learning.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Software Architects, and Engineering leaders to align the transformation roadmap with user needs and business goals.
  • Partner with Product Marketing, UX, and QA, to ensure cohesive customer experiences as desktop and cloud modules converge.
  • Establish feedback loops between product development, product marketing, customer success, sales and global marketing to drive iterative improvement.
  • Define measurable KPIs for transformation success: cloud adoption rates, AI feature engagement, comprehensive milestones, and customer satisfaction.

Change Management & Enablement

  • Drive cultural and organizational readiness for cloud-first and AI-augmented product delivery.
  • Lead internal communication and enablement programs to align teams on transformation milestones and metrics.
  • Mentor and develop team members in modern SaaS, AI, and cloud product practices.
  • Oversee early access and beta programs for cloud and AI features.

The Talents We’re Seeking

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field required.
  • Master’s degree in Business Administration (MBA), Engineering Management, or equivalent preferred.
  • 15+ years of experience in product management or product transformation leadership within software or industrial technology sectors.
  • 5+ years of experience managing teams of Product Owners and Product Managers required.
  • Proven track record of leading desktop-to-cloud migrations or large-scale product modernization initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of cloud architectures (Azure/AWS), SaaS business models, and AI/ML product integration.
  • Technical fluency with modern development environments, CI/CD pipelines, APIs, and data platforms.
  • Exceptional leadership and communication skills, able to align cross-functional teams and inspire organizational change, influence without authority.

Required Skills

  • Background in CAD/CAM, manufacturing software, or industrial automation.
  • Experience integrating AI copilots, cloud microservices, or connected ecosystems in enterprise software.
  • Familiarity with PLM systems, and hybrid deployment models.
  • Demonstrated ability to balance technical modernization with user-centric product value.
  • Experience with SaaS monetization models and organizational change management.

Who We Are

At Mastercam, we do not just keep pace with manufacturing—we set the pace. For over 40 years, we have been the name behind the breakthroughs, the partner for those who refuse to settle. When the industry says “too complex,” we say, “challenge accepted.”

We are more than software. We are a movement of makers, innovators, and problem-solvers driving transformation across the globe.

Backed by a network of 400 Channel Partners and a thriving developer community, Mastercam delivers the tools and expertise to turn ambitious ideas into flawless reality. From aerospace to automotive, medical to education, we empower manufacturers to push boundaries and redefine what is possible.

As part of Intelligent Manufacturing and the Sandvik Group, we are leading the charge in digital transformation. Our team of 350+ professionals is united by a single mission: to help achieve precision, productivity, and performance without compromise.

Our Core Values? They are not just words. They are how we win:

  • Winning Together: Collaboration is not optional—it is the engine that drives us.
  • Curiosity: We question, we explore, we innovate. Every day.
  • Responsibility: Safety, integrity, and sustainability aren’t boxes to check—they are the foundation of trust.
  • Customer-Focused: We listen. We adapt. We deliver. Always.

Innovation. Collaboration. Growth. That is the Mastercam way. Explore more at , connect on LinkedIn, and join the conversation with #mastercam.

The next big challenge is waiting—are you ready to accept?

Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: SEO Specialist

Compensation range: $2,000 AUD / Monthly

Engagement type:Independent Contractor Agreement

Work Schedule: This role is expected to align with the AU business hours (approx. 9 AM - 5 PM, Monday to Friday) for collaboration, but as a contractor, you’ll have flexibility in how you manage your time.

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: Our client is an established Australian digital marketing agency supporting businesses with end-to-end digital solutions designed to improve their online presence, generate leads, and achieve measurable business outcomes.

The agency works across a broad range of digital services, combining creative, technical, and performance-focused expertise to deliver tailored solutions for its clients. Their team takes a results-driven approach, with a strong focus on transparency, quality, collaboration, and long-term client relationships.

Role Overview: We are hiring a senior, AI enabled SEO specialist to work alongside our Australian staff, not underneath them. You will own SEO delivery across a portfolio of client sites end to end: audit, plan, execute, report.

The AI part is not a buzzword on the ad. It is how we expect the work to get done. Search itself is changing, with AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini now sitting between our clients and their customers, and the way SEO work is produced is changing just as fast. We want someone who already uses AI daily to do the work of a much larger team, and who has the judgement to know when the AI is wrong.

This is a hands-on role for someone who has already run their own client book and does not need daily direction. If you need a task list handed to you each morning, this is not the one.

You will report directly to the Head of SEO, in Perth. The Philippines and Perth share the same timezone (UTC+8), so you are on the same clock as the team. No split shift and no overnight work.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own on page and technical SEO across a portfolio of roughly 10 to 20 client WordPress sites
  • Run technical audits and fix what you find: crawl issues, indexation, redirects, site structure, Core Web Vitals, schema
  • Optimise for AI search as well as Google. Structure content and schema so clients get cited in AI Overviews and LLM answers, and track where they are appearing
  • Use AI to scale the work: research, clustering, brief generation, first draft copy, bulk meta data, audit summarisation, report commentary, with a human check before anything ships
  • Build and improve repeatable AI workflows for the team, so a task done well once gets done fast every time after
  • Keyword research and content briefs mapped to client services and commercial intent
  • Write and optimise page copy, meta data and blog content to a standard that reads human, never generic
  • Google Business Profile optimisation and local SEO for WA service area businesses
  • Build monthly client reports in Looker Studio that explain what changed and why, not just charts
  • Monitor rankings, traffic and conversions, and flag drops before the client does
  • Migration QA: pre launch SEO checks, redirect maps, post launch verification
  • Work with our developers on implementation, and QA it once it is live
  • Bring recommendations to the Head of SEO and the Perth team proactively. We want a second brain, not a pair of hands

Requirements

  • 5+ years in SEO, with at least 2 in an agency managing multiple client accounts at once
  • Demonstrable daily use of AI tools in real SEO delivery (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or similar). They can show us workflows they have built, not just tools they have tried
  • Editorial judgement over AI output. They know what AI generated content sounds like and they do not let it out the door. Clients get work that reads like a person wrote it, because they rewrote it
  • Working understanding of AI search: how AI Overviews and LLM answers pick sources, and what to change on a site to be one of them
  • Genuine technical SEO capability. They can read a crawl report, diagnose the cause and specify the fix
  • Strong WordPress experience: Yoast or RankMath, page builders, plugin level troubleshooting
  • Google Search Console, GA4 and Looker Studio to a reporting ready standard
  • Screaming Frog or equivalent, and SEMrush or Ahrefs, used daily rather than occasionally
  • Excellent written English. They will write client facing copy and reports that go out with our name on them
  • Able to work independently across a portfolio and manage their own priorities
  • Reliable home office setup and stable internet, available 8:00am to 4:00pm AWST

NICE TO HAVE SKILLS

  • Automation platforms such as n8n, Make or Zapier, for connecting SEO tasks, data and reporting
  • Custom GPTs, Claude Projects, or their own prompt library built for repeat client work
  • Light scripting in Python or Apps Script, including AI assisted, for bulk data work and API pulls
  • HTML and CSS literacy, enough to diagnose and make small front end fixes themselves
  • Cloudflare, GTM or Zaraz, or server side tagging exposure WooCommerce or e-commerce SEO
  • Google Ads familiarity, enough to see where paid and organic overlap
  • Experience mentoring or QA'ing junior SEO work
  • Australian market experience, or a track record with English speaking Western clients

IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE

  • Someone senior enough to be trusted with client outcomes and steady enough to still be here in three years.
  • AI native, not AI dependent. Uses AI to move faster on everything, and still owns every word that ships
  • Independent. Runs their own week, chases their own loose ends, escalates early when something is off
  • Diagnostic. Does not just report that traffic dropped. Finds out why and proposes the fix
  • Curious about the shift. Search is being rebuilt right now and we want someone who finds that interesting rather than threatening
  • Communicative. Writes clearly, updates without being asked, comfortable saying "that recommendation will not work, here is why"
  • Long term. We are building a role, not filling a gap. Growth into leading SEO delivery alongside the Head of SEO as the client base grows is on the table

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)

raw.title: Senior Software Engineer - SRE
raw.excerpt: When the Tarr Steps, a footbridge assembled of heavy stones in Exmoor National Park in England, washed away in a flood in 1942, the Royal Engineers rebuilt it.
raw.description:
When the Tarr Steps, a footbridge assembled of heavy stones in Exmoor National Park in England, washed away in a flood in 1942, the Royal Engineers rebuilt it. Then it washed away again in 1952. So the Royal Engineers heaved in more stones: on and on, like a Sisyphean lesson in absurdity.

Of course, they do this because the Tarr Steps are a historical monument, believed to be built during the Bronze Age. Modern bridge building looks a lot different and generally requires less upkeep. While we appreciate the charm of ancient things, Mercury is engineering the future of banking*. "Quaint" and "archaic" are not values we seek in our systems. Rebooting a tumbling server and hoping a flood of requests doesn't wash it away can be an emergency tactic, but we actively seek out durable solutions over monotonous ops work. You'll bring this ethos and teach others how to live it too.

Up to this point, the Stability team at Mercury has primarily built platform-level constructs that product teams adopt. However, those teams are asking for us to work more closely with them to mature their implementations and practices. We are creating an SRE team that will rotate through product teams. You will understand the team's domain, identify opportunities for improvements in reliability/observability/performance/preparedness and create self-reinforcing, virtuous cycles.

As part of this role, you will:

  • Embed with product teams, helping them improve their operational maturity by setting up and refining practices around on-call, monitoring, alerting, and run books
  • Run regular game day exercises with product teams, helping them feel more prepared to investigate and quickly remediate incidents
  • Jump into application code written in Haskell & TypeScript and implement reliability techniques such as retries, better error handling, better logging, circuit breaking, etc
  • Steer SLOs towards meaningful customer outcomes that product teams are accountable for. Those SLOs become a strong signal for whether the product is working as intended
  • Champion reliability practices through design document and code reviews
  • Identify observability gaps that hinder debugging, incident response, and business intelligence and help close those
  • Advocate for longer-term improvements that non-product engineering teams can drive
  • Participate in the product team's on-call rotation while embedding or as part of a more general engineering rotation, helping us improve processes and how we learn from incidents

The ideal candidate for the role:

  • Has past Site Reliability Engineering or DevOps experience
  • Has measurable examples of influencing an organization towards greater reliability
  • Has significant experience with PostgreSQL
  • Has authored and operated Temporal workflows
  • Has experience with observability platforms like Grafana or Honeycomb
  • Has familiarity with OpenTelemetry

If this role interests you, we invite you to explore our public demo at .

Job Title: Sr. CRA 1 - Site Management

Job Location: Reading, Berkshire, United Kingdom

Join Us on Our Mission to Drive Healthcare Forward

IQVIA UK’s Site Management team is growing, and we’re hiring two Senior CRAs. Join us to build a meaningful career, drive real impact, and continue your professional growth.

Job Overview
Perform monitoring and site management work to ensure that sites are conducting the study(ies) and reporting study data as required by the study protocol, applicable regulations and guidelines, and sponsor requirements.

Essential Functions
• Perform site monitoring visits (selection, initiation, monitoring and close-out visits) in accordance with contracted scope of work and Good Clinical Practice.
• Work with sites to adapt, drive, and track subject recruitment plan in line with project needs to enhance predictability.
• Administer protocol and related study training to assigned sites and establish regular lines of communication with sites to manage ongoing project expectations and issues.
• Evaluate the quality and integrity of study site practices related to the proper conduct of the protocol and adherence to applicable regulations. Escalate quality issues as appropriate.
• Manage the progress of assigned studies by tracking regulatory submissions and approvals, recruitment and enrollment, case report form (CRF) completion and submission, and data query generation and resolution. May support start-up phase.
• Ensure copies/originals (as required) site documents are available for filing in the Trial Master File (TMF) and verify that the Investigator's Site File (ISF) is maintained in accordance with GCP and local regulatory requirements.
• Create and maintain appropriate documentation regarding site management, monitoring visit findings and action plans by submitting regular visit reports, generating follow-up letters and other required study documentation.
• Collaborate and liaise with study team members for project execution support as appropriate.
• If applicable, may be accountable for supporting development of project subject recruitment plan on a per site basis.
• If applicable, may be accountable for site financial management according to executed clinical trial agreement and retrieve invoices according to local requirement.

Qualifications
• Bachelor's Degree Degree in scientific discipline or health care preferred. Req
• Requires at least 2 years of on-site monitoring experience. Req
• Good knowledge of, and skill in applying, applicable clinical research regulatory requirements.
• i.e., Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) guidelines.
• Good therapeutic and protocol knowledge as provided in company training.
• Computer skills including proficiency in use of Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint and use of a laptop computer and iPhone and iPad (where applicable).
• Written and verbal communication skills including good command of English language.
• Organizational and problem-solving skills.
• Effective time and financial management skills.
• Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with coworkers, managers, and clients.

  • Please note - this role is not eligible for UK visa sponsorship*

We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

raw.description:
WEB DEVELOPER

Independent Contractor | Remote | Minimum 10 Hours/Week

This is an independent contractor (1099) position. VaVa contractors are responsible for managing their own taxes, benefits, and business expenses.

VaVa Virtual Assistants is a remote company based out of Atlanta, Georgia, built on the belief that businesses thrive when they have the right support behind them. We connect clients across industries like nonprofit, legal, coaching, and finance with skilled virtual professionals who bring genuine expertise to the work. Our team may be distributed, but the culture is deeply connected through daily conversation, project collaboration, and regular all-company virtual gatherings.

We are looking for an experienced Web Developer who is already freelancing or running their own web development practice and wants to supplement that work with additional client projects through VaVa. This role calls for both front end and backend expertise, along with the technical range to move between quick maintenance requests, full site builds, and ecommerce or security work as each project demands.

Beyond your client work, you will be part of a contractor community that genuinely invests in one another's success. Regular calls with clients and fellow contractors keep you connected to the broader VaVa team, and every interaction is an opportunity to reflect our mission, vision, and values.

Please review the requirements and qualifications below carefully, as they reflect what it truly takes to succeed in this role. We appreciate your interest in joining the team.

EXPECTATIONS

Represent VaVa Virtual Assistants in a Positive and Professional Manner

  • Demonstrate strong technical judgment and professionalism in every client interaction.
  • Ensure all communication reflects VaVa's values and standard of quality.
  • Contribute to a collaborative culture among fellow VaVa contractors, including designers or other specialists who may support your projects.

Take Ownership of Client Satisfaction

  • Manage client website projects and ongoing support requests with reliability and follow-through.
  • Anticipate technical needs before they become urgent issues, and communicate proactively about progress and timelines.
  • Deliver work that meets each client's brand, functionality, and performance goals.
  • Adjust availability and scope as project demands shift, from routine maintenance to full site builds or migrations.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design, develop, and maintain websites for multiple clients across a range of industries, primarily using WordPress.
  • Build and customize front end interfaces using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript that align with each client's brand and goals.
  • Develop, troubleshoot, and maintain backend functionality using PHP, resolving issues promptly to minimize downtime and disruption to client business.
  • Manage e-commerce site builds and ongoing maintenance on platforms such as WooCommerce, Shopify, or ThriveCart.
  • Execute website migrations, domain transfers, and hosting changes with minimal disruption to client operations.
  • Configure and maintain website security measures to protect client sites from vulnerabilities, downtime, and unauthorized access.
  • Build landing pages and set up automations and system integrations, using tools such as Zapier, Make, or n8n, and email marketing platforms such as ConvertKit or Klaviyo, when a client's project calls for it.
  • Monitor website analytics and traffic, and optimize client sites for search engines and answer engines using current SEO and AEO practices, reporting on client-defined performance metrics.
  • Use AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT to support development work, troubleshoot issues, and build custom workflows for clients, staying current on emerging web development tools and AI-assisted practices.
  • Collaborate with designers, including VaVa contractors supporting brand, graphic design, or content writing needs, when a project calls for additional creative support.
  • Gather and refine project requirements directly from clients, and communicate timelines, progress, and technical concepts in accessible, non-technical language.
  • Provide ongoing maintenance and ad hoc support for existing client sites, managing multiple concurrent projects and balancing routine work with new builds and migrations.
  • Maintain clear documentation of site structure, credentials, and technical decisions for each client project.
  • Complete additional web development tasks as requested, within the scope of the contractor engagement.

GENERAL QUALIFICATIONS

  • Must reside and be authorized to work in the United States.
  • At least 3 years of demonstrated experience in front end and backend web development.
  • At least 2 years of experience working full-time in a virtual or remote capacity.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting multiple clients across different industries; candidates who are actively running their own web development practice or taking on independent freelance engagements are strongly preferred.
  • Available a minimum of 10 hours per week, with flexibility to take on additional ad hoc client projects as they arise.

TECHNICAL QUALIFICATIONS

Must Have

  • Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with backend development experience in PHP.
  • Proficiency in WordPress, including theme customization, plugin management, site migrations, and troubleshooting, along with experience on at least one ecommerce platform such as WooCommerce, Shopify, or ThriveCart.
  • Experience with SEO and answer engine optimization (AEO), including Google Analytics, Search Console, and Tag Manager.
  • Experience with automation and systems integration tools such as Zapier, Make, or n8n, and email marketing or landing page platforms such as ConvertKit or Klaviyo.
  • Experience implementing website security best practices to protect client sites from vulnerabilities and downtime.
  • AI literacy, including experience using tools such as Claude or ChatGPT to support development work and improve workflow efficiency.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, Slack, and Zoom.
  • Experience with at least one project management tool and one CRM tool.

Preferred

  • Experience with alternate website builder platforms such as Webflow, Wix, or Squarespace, or with AI-assisted builders such as Showit, Loveable, or Durable.
  • Graphic design and UX/UI experience, including wireframing in Figma or Adobe Illustrator.
  • Familiarity with Git/GitHub, SQL, or Python.

EDUCATION

A degree is not required. Demonstrated competency and a strong portfolio of front end work always outweigh credentials.

A degree or certificate in web development, computer science, or a related field is a plus, but not required.

Candidates without a degree should hold at least one relevant certification. Examples include: WordPress certification, AWS Certified Developer, a Google Analytics certification, or a foundational security certification like CompTIA Security+.

A commitment to continued learning is an expectation of this role. New technology and software capabilities shift regularly; staying current is part of the job.

The role will support original Axios video programming, including The Axios Show, and other editorial video formats across YouTube, social, and digital platforms.

Why it matters: Axios is investing in high-quality, audience-focused video storytelling. The Producer/Senior Producer will partner with editorial, video, social, audience, revenue, and external production partners to turn strong ideas into compelling, visually engaging video. This person will be equally comfortable developing a treatment, directing a shoot, editing a finished piece, managing production timelines, and working with on-camera talent.

Go deeper: In this role, you’ll:

  • Produce video from ideation through scripting, shooting, post-production, publishing, and promotion.

  • Work effectively with journalists, executives, guests, and other on-camera talent.
  • Coordinate work across internal teams, freelancers, contractors, vendors, and production partners.
  • Create video optimized for YouTube and other digital platforms, including packaging, audience retention, and distribution.
  • Use platform trends and performance insights to inform creative decisions and help grow Axios’ video audience.
  • Manage multiple projects, deadlines, production schedules, and review processes in a fast-moving environment.

The details: You have:

  • 5–7+ years of relevant video production, journalism, digital media, broadcast, documentary, branded-content, or comparable editorial experience; additional experience may be considered at the Senior Producer level.
  • Demonstrated experience producing, shooting, and editing professional video content, supported by a strong portfolio or reel.
  • Strong editorial judgment, visual storytelling skills, and the ability to turn ideas into compelling finished video.
  • Experience producing for YouTube and an understanding of audience development, search/discovery, retention, and platform-native storytelling.
  • Expert proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Experience working with on-camera talent, alongside strong writing, communication, and project-management skills.
  • A collaborative, entrepreneurial, solutions-oriented approach and comfort working across distributed teams and changing priorities.

Starting salary for this role is in the range of $90,000 - $140,000 and is dependent on numerous factors, including but not limited to location, work experience, and skills. This role involves developing and implementing security policies, incident response protocols, and security monitoring strategies. The ideal candidate will be proactive, detail-oriented, and capable of identifying and mitigating security threats to protect the organization's assets, data, and reputation. In this role, you will lead by example of being a highly technical leader who delivers high business impact on multiple projects of increasing dependencies and ambiguity.

Primary Duties:

    1. Impact: Balance short and long-term business impact by developing strategies to manage risks, including:
      1. Security Operations Center (SOC) Oversight
      2. Incident Response and Threat Management
      3. Security Monitoring and Threat Intelligence
      4. Vulnerability Management
      5. Security Policies and Compliance:
      6. Risk Management
      7. Anticipate industry AI/AIOps trends to optimize automation, log-ingestion, and threat response-balancing rapid incident resolution with security quality.
    2. People: Develop outstanding teams using a combination of world-class-hiring and direct-timely-actionable feedback to develop security talent.
    3. Execution: Set aggressive yet clear goals and remove all roadblocks for the team to achieve them.
    4. Collaboration: Develop strong relationships and work cross-functionally with many partners across organizations and functions, and as a result, increase the impact of the team’s work.
    5. Company: Work closely with company-wide leaders to drive excellence in our processes and systems that protect patients, our employees, and Aledade as a whole.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field (Master’s degree preferred).
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in security operations, with at least 5 years in a leadership or management role.
  • Proven experience in managing a SOC and leading incident response efforts.
  • Strong understanding of security technologies, including SIEM, IDS/IPS, EDR, firewalls, and vulnerability management tools.
  • Ability to work effectively in high-pressure situations and manage multiple priorities.
  • Experience with regulatory compliance requirements (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS).

Preferred Knowledge, Skills and/or Abilities:

  • Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a proactive and forward-thinking approach.
  • In-depth knowledge of security frameworks and standards (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Controls).

Who We Are:

Aledade PBC, a public benefit corporation, exists to empower the most transformational part of our health care landscape - independent primary care. We were founded in 2014, and since then, we've become the largest network of independent primary care in the country - helping practices, health centers and clinics deliver better care to their patients and thrive in value-based care. Additionally, by creating value-based contracts across a wide variety of health plans, we aim to flip the script on the traditional fee-for-service model. Our work strengthens continuity of care, aligns incentives and ensures primary care physicians are paid for what they do best - keeping patients healthy. If you want to help create a health care system that is good for patients, good for practices and good for society - and if you're eager to join a collaborative, inclusive and remote-first culture - you've come to the right place.

What Does This Mean for You?

At Aledade PBC, you will be part of a creative culture that is driven by a passion for tackling complex issues with respect, open-mindedness and a desire to learn. You will collaborate with team members who bring a wide range of experiences, interests, backgrounds, beliefs and achievements to their work - and who are all united by a shared passion for public health and a commitment to the Aledade mission.
In addition to time off to support work-life balance and enjoyment, we offer the following comprehensive benefits package designed for the overall well-being of our team members:
Flexible work schedules and the ability to work remotely are available for many roles
Health, dental and vision insurance paid up to 80% for employees, dependents and domestic partners
Robust time-off plan (21 days of PTO in your first year)
Two paid volunteer days and 11 paid holidays
12 weeks paid parental leave for all new parents
Six weeks paid sabbatical after six years of service
Educational Assistant Program and Clinical Employee Reimbursement Program
401(k) with up to 4% match
Stock options

raw.excerpt: As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations.
raw.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:

Our team builds the foundational platform that powers CrowdStrike’s massive scale. We focus on creating self-service infrastructure-as-a-code primitives, ensuring high availability, and optimizing our cloud footprint to empower our engineering teams to move faster with confidence.

What You’ll Do:

  • Please note that if you are close to one of our office locations we would ask that you partake in a hybrid work schedule.

  • Manage a growing team of engineers focused on building quality platforms.

  • Participate in architecting large scale core infrastructure services for service teams at CrowdStrike.

  • Participate in regular retros, capacity and planning meetings with your team, allowing team collaboration and discussions in a high fidelity manner.

  • Be part of “lunch and learn” demos: for new POCs or design sessions to work out new architectures.

  • Flexible working - with transparent communication, we encourage flexible working and a healthy work life balance.

  • Responsible for reviewing, providing feedback and approving new design proposals from your team.

  • Help plan the product roadmap

  • Drive cloud cost optimization efforts, balancing high-performance requirements with operational efficiency and budget awareness.

  • Define and enforce standards for service deployments, ensuring consistency across our complex, multi-cloud environment.

What You’ll Need (Technical)

  • Experience in Configuration Management (Chef, Puppet, Salt or similar solutions)

  • Experience in Provisioning & Orchestration (Pulumi, Terraform, Ansible, Temporal or similar solutions)

  • Experience with immutable architecture and distributed systems design.

  • Experience in software development, design patterns, data structures and algorithms ( Python or Go )

  • Experience with large-scale, business-critical Linux environments.

  • Experience operating within the cloud, AWS & GCP preferred.

  • Experience with TDD, CI/CD, Chaos Engineering or similar resilience and reliability practices for infrastructure development.

  • Knowledge of SRE, Devops and Gitops practices

  • 8+ years industry experience

  • Experience in building and managing reusable infrastructure modules and internal developer platforms (IDP).

  • Strong understanding of SRE principles, including SLO management, error budget planning, and post-incident analysis.

  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

What You’ll Need (Leadership)

  • Proven ability to work effectively with both local and remote teams.

  • Rock solid communication skills, verbal and written.

  • A combination of confidence and independence, with the prudence to know when to ask for help from the rest of the team.

  • Experience with managing on-call

  • 4+ years of experience as a people manager

  • Led a team of Senior Engineers

  • Proven track record of influencing engineering strategy beyond your immediate team, and acting as a technical consultant to other product engineering groups.

Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike:

  • Market leader in compensation and equity awards

  • Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs

  • Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge

  • Paid parental and adoption leaves

  • Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role

  • Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections

  • Vibrant office culture with world class amenities

  • Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe

CrowdStrike is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a culture of belonging where everyone is valued for who they are and empowered to succeed. We support veterans and individuals with disabilities through our affirmative action program.

raw.description:
IT Support Analyst is accountable for the development and support (first level) of organization’s IT Service Desk Solutions.

Responsibilities

  • First line of IT support for all team members via phone calls, emails, service desk requests, in person and remotely within an Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) framework.
  • Onboarding and offboarding team members and ensuring customer queries are captured, validated, and triaged within the ticketing system.
  • Troubleshooting common or basic technical issues, such as account and access related issues.
  • Maintaining knowledge base with common problems which can be accessed by customers.
  • Escalating cases to 2nd level support – Senior Support Specialist, Desktop Support Specialist and Infrastructure Team, where required.
  • Taking ownership of tickets including tracking, monitoring, following up, prioritising, and escalating incidents and coordinating with appropriate resources to resolve issues in a timely manner.
  • Actively reviewing and resolving helpdesk requests raised by the business, with a focus on root cause resolution.
  • Developing and maintaining key internal and external relationships, including liaising with stakeholders on policy, project or operational issues and responding to stakeholder needs and expectations.
  • Supporting the Service Delivery and Infrastructure Team to achieve high service uptime, by providing system information and updates regarding system performance and outages.
  • Supporting the Service Delivery and Infrastructure Team by managing the hardware asset registers to ensure manageable stock levels.
  • Role modelling organization's values (Accountability, Care, Team)

Skills

  • Highly developed written and oral communication skills, particularly in discussing technical matters with non-technical people.
  • Good prioritisation and time management skills.
  • Ability to work creatively and analytically to solve problems
  • Knowledge in supporting PC, software, in a Windows environment.

Experience

  • Experience in a customer service environment.
  • Experience working within a team, in a fast pacedand constantly changing environment.
  • Managing and effectively dealing with service requests and prioritising workload. I have these qualifications
  • Degree or Diploma in Information Technology, or related area desirable
